mapper.select: SELECT id, config_name AS configName, config_code AS configCode, service_provider AS serviceProvider, endpoint, access_key AS accessKey, secret_key AS secretKey, bucket_name AS bucketName, bucket_region AS bucketRegion, prefix_path AS prefixPath, public_url AS publicUrl, remark FROM bedrock_oss_config WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, config_code AS configCode, service_provider AS serviceProvider, endpoint, access_key AS accessKey, secret_key AS secretKey, bucket_name AS bucketName, bucket_region AS bucketRegion, prefix_path AS prefixPath, public_url AS publicUrl FROM bedrock_oss_config
is_deleted = 0
and config_code = #{configCode}
and status = 1
limit 1

SELECT id, config_name AS configName, config_code AS configCode, service_provider AS serviceProvider, endpoint, bucket_name AS bucketName, bucket_region AS bucketRegion, prefix_path AS prefixPath, public_url AS publicUrl, status, remark FROM bedrock_oss_config WHERE is_deleted = 0
and config_name like concat('%', #{param.configName}, '%')
and config_code like concat('%', #{param.configCode}, '%')
and service_provider = #{param.serviceProvider}
